items.description: Sri Aurobindo Society transparent Symbol. Meaning/Description of Symbol: It is the symbol of Sri Aurobindo, with lines joining the apexes of the two triangles to form a diamond. The significance of the diamond, according to Sri Aurobindo, is the Mother's light at its intensest.
